title: Product Story & Landing Documentation
observations: Concept pass was effective for terminology research (3 conflicts caught) and narrative structure, but lacked 'red-phase probes' for concrete examples — AC3 FAIL in round 1
AC5 (status/framing) was pre-implementation check that should have been concept gate, not review finding — missed in round 1
Two-review cycle was proportional: round 1 found 2 critical gaps (AC3, AC5), round 2 verified fixes — no rework needed after fix cycle
Strong editorial voice consistency across 4 docs required zero rewriting for tone/clarity — established in first draft
Cost signal: 9.3h productive to deliver 2366 words of authoritative product documentation (~233 words/hour)
Documentation workpackages need different review lenses (completeness, clarity, consistency, tone) vs code review lenses
Recommend 3 process improvements: (1) red-phase probes in concept for docs, (2) mandatory structural elements checklist, (3) docs-specific review template
